name: Laws
overview: Scripture reveals that the laws governing human conduct are ultimately established by God, who is our judge, lawgiver, and king, as seen in Isaiah 33:22. Believers are called to seek, obey, and teach God's statutes, exemplified by Ezra's dedication in Ezra 7:10, recognizing the enduring nature of God's law that will not fail (Luke 16:17). While human laws and authorities exist and are ordained by God (Romans 13:1), the conscience testifies to the work of God's law within every heart (Romans 2:15), and those who uphold the law stand against wickedness (Proverbs 28:4). This underscores a Christ-centered view where divine law is supreme over man-made laws and societal regulations.
